svg.title: quietframe: noise-adaptive denoising for Log camera footage
svg.desc: Animated frame whose film grain fades away as a scan line sweeps across it, above the pipeline Log, LUT, denoise, Rec.709. Measured on a Canon EOS R6 V in Canon Log 2 at ISO 6400: residual noise 44 percent, detail kept 96 percent.
svg.text: Noise-adaptive denoising for Log camera footage.
Denoise after the Log → Rec.709 LUT. Strength measured per clip.
Canon Log 2 · Canon Log 3 · ffmpeg · Python · Claude Code skill
